connector.name: ChromaDB Remote MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Remote ChromaDB vector database MCP server with streamable HTTP transport
connector.summary: Hosted at meloncafe.github.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image chromadb-remote-mcp:latest. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the meloncafe account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Authentication token for the MCP server (if enabled)
